observations: portable_manifest deliberately drops cpu_reference.sha256, clean_png_sha256 and clean_png_bytes from the normalized manifest comparison because the embedded PNG compression can change. Full --check separately verifies all three against the checked-in SVG/PNG; the temp negative probes directly confirm wrong cpu_reference.sha256, clean_png_sha256, generator hash and pfm_sha256 values are rejected.

A repo-wide WSL git diff over all *.svg reports 47 pre-existing CRLF-only differences under material/, nanite-lumen/, scene/ and walkthrough/. Replacing CRLF with LF makes each file identical to HEAD, and Windows git (core.autocrlf=true) reports none. These files are outside the reviewed generator output directories and were not modified.
All probes were CPU-only and read-only with respect to tracked files; temporary directories were used for full --check negative runs. No GPU, engine, capture, or broad test suite was run.
